facts.text: Case Western Reserve University requires incoming students to reside in on-campus housing for their first two years.

sources.title: Living On-Campus | Division of Student Affairs
sources.quote: CWRU has a two-year residency requirement, where all incoming students for the 2026-2027 academic year are required to reside in on-campus housing for their first two years.

facts.text: Case Western Reserve University meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted undergraduate students.

sources.title: Net Price Calculator and MyinTuition | Financial Aid
sources.quote: CWRU provides a robust program of merit scholarships and need-based aid and meets 100% of demonstrated need for all admitted undergraduate students.
